learning-loop.title: Learning loop
learning-loop.body: The more you chat, the more your work patterns collect here. See what RICE has learned and which skills were auto-generated at a glance.

chat-input.title: Chat input
chat-input.body: Send messages to the agent here. Type / to instantly pull up saved skills — attachments are supported too.

model-settings.title: Model settings
model-settings.body: Check and switch your connected AI model — hosted in the cloud or running locally via Ollama.

my-skills.title: My Skills
my-skills.body: Manage skills auto-generated from chats or built by hand. Run them instantly with / commands, and they improve automatically as you use them.

myplugins.title: My Plugins
myplugins.body: Manage installed plugins. A plugin is a bundle of skills — install one and the agent becomes an expert in that domain.

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.body: Connect external services like Google Drive and Notion. Once connected, plugins use them automatically.

skills-market.title: Skill Market
skills-market.body: Find community-built skills and install them instantly. Add all kinds of workflows in one click.

plugins-market.title: Plugin Market
plugins-market.body: Browse plugins that package domain expertise. Add specialists for areas like legal, data analysis, and workflow automation.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Reconfigure model connections and app preferences anytime. Even after onboarding, you can change or add AI models here.
